name: Ricardo Alves
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the vibrant liveries of Formula 1 cars. He spent countless hours meticulously replicating these designs on model cars, honing his attention to detail. This passion led him to pursue vocational training in automotive painting and eventually landed him a role at a local custom car shop, where he quickly became known for his ability to match any color and execute complex paint schemes flawlessly.

Ricardo approaches his work with a deep sense of pride and precision. He understands that the paint job is more than just aesthetics; it's a reflection of the team's identity and attention to detail. He's always seeking out new techniques and materials to improve the quality and durability of his work. What sets Ricardo apart is his unwavering commitment to perfection. He won't rest until every panel is flawlessly finished, ensuring that the cars leaving his shop look their absolute best on the track.

His move to Academy Motorsport was a dream come true, allowing him to combine his love of motorsport with his professional skillset.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium height and build, with a focused look.

quirks: Always wears a pair of lucky racing gloves while mixing paints.
Has an encyclopedic knowledge of classic racing liveries.
Listens to samba music while working to maintain focus.
